name: CentOS Stream
description: CentOS Stream 10 or 9, imported from official GenericCloud QCOW2 images with mandatory Cloud-Init.

notes.text: Choose CentOS Stream 10 (default) or 9 during setup or set VM_OS_VERSION=10 or VM_OS_VERSION=9 when unattended.
Cloud-Init is required to configure credentials and initial guest networking. The image's default user is cloud-user; select a password or SSH key during setup.
The script downloads a current official CentOS GenericCloud image and checks its SHA-256 checksum, including cached images.
